fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) is trading at $380.11, down 15.48% from the beginning of the year, but would require a 57.8% gain to reach a 2027 target price of $600.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 FSD subscriptions increased from 1.04M to 1.74M, and the company has gained business momentum with Cybercab and Optimus production commencement, though Q3 operating income declined 55.79% to $718M.
fields.summary_ko.2: Based on 2027 EPS consensus of $2.1592, the current stock price is valued at a 176x P/E; at $600, this would rise to 278x, requiring strong execution by the company.
